source.section: Recorded oauth.v2.access response of an installation with bot scopes only, 2021-06-08
source.note: Not a recording and not a copy. Field names, nesting and types follow that public recording: authed_user holds only id, team only id, enterprise is null and is_enterprise_install false. The values are those of the bot and user example on https://docs.slack.dev/reference/methods/oauth.v2.access (Response, retrieved 2026-11-03); the token value is a placeholder.
